note.summary: This chunk describes HMRC's internal ARTG guidance on how a customer's appeal proceeds after being sent to HMRC: either via a review (HMRC-offered or customer-requested) or by notification to the tribunal. It sets out timeframes (30 days to accept a review offer or go to tribunal, 45 days for HMRC to conduct a review, 30 days to appeal to tribunal after review conclusion) and the consequence of inaction (appeal treated as settled by agreement under s49C/s49F TMA 1970). It also covers the special rule for Simple Assessments, which carry no right of appeal unless the customer first raises a query under s31AA TMA 1970 within 60 days, and separately describes parallel processes for indirect tax decisions (VATA 1994 s83D) and restoration decisions.
